input_address.description: The primary IPv4 or IPv6 address or network to perform calculations on.

format_string.description: Printf-style format string defining output fields (e.g., %a for IP, %c for CIDR, %n for network).

force_ipv4.description: If true, restrict processing to IPv4 addresses (-4/--ipv4).

force_ipv6.description: If true, restrict processing to IPv6 addresses (-6/--ipv6).

subnet_mask.description: CIDR mask to apply to the input address (-m/--mask). Empty string means no override.

number_base.description: Base for numeric interpretation of input/output addresses (-b/--base: 8, 10, 16).

show_available.description: If true, when used with a source list, prints only addresses not currently assigned to the network (-a/--available).

csv_file.description: Path to a CSV file for matching networks (-c/--csv). Empty string means no CSV processing.

csv_field.description: Column name in the CSV to use for matching networks (-i/--field).

source_file.description: Path to a file containing a list of IP addresses to process (-s/--file). Empty string means stdin or no source file.

match_inside.description: If true, only print addresses from the source file that are inside the input network (--inside).

match_outside.description: If true, only print addresses from the source file that are outside the input network (--outside).

reverse_inputs.description: If true, treat inputs/sources as back-to-front (--reverse).

divide_cidr.description: CIDR mask to divide the input network into subnets (--divide). Empty string means no division.

encapsulating.description: If true, return the encapsulating/containing network (--encapsulating).
